name: companion_shadow_adapter_no_wire_guard
purpose: Prove the Stage 6V Companion shadow adapter helper exists but is not wired into runtime request handling.
safety_invariants: Companion shadow adapter helper may exist only as a helper
Companion shadow adapter must not be imported into edge_controller.py
Companion shadow adapter must not be called by any HTTP route
Companion shadow adapter must not be called by frontend code
Companion shadow adapter must not change Companion behavior
Companion shadow adapter must not change Chat behavior
router dry-run endpoint remains disabled by default
